# EquiFin Advisory

> Independent corporate finance and debt advisory firm helping Indian businesses structure and raise corporate debt, project finance, working capital and structured credit.

EquiFin Advisory does not act as a lender and does not extend credit or accept deposits. The firm works with growth-stage and established businesses on capital structuring, transaction strategy and institutional execution, across corporate finance, project finance, working capital, supply chain finance, real estate funding, lease rental discounting, strategic finance advisory and credit rating advisory — for businesses in real estate, infrastructure, renewable energy, manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, hospitality, technology and financial services.

## Key Facts

- Headquarters: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Average turnaround time: 15–60 days, from completion of the Information Memorandum (IM) / CMA process to sanction letter issuance
- 60+ active institutional lending relationships across PSU banks, private banks, Tier-1 NBFCs and private credit institutions
- 94% sanction-to-disbursement ratio across completed mandates
- Geographic coverage: businesses and transactions across India

## Services

- [Corporate Finance](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-corporate-finance.html): Debt advisory for growth, acquisitions and refinancing.
- [Debt Syndication](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-debt-syndication.html): Lender mapping and coordinated execution across multiple lenders.
- [Project Finance](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-project-finance.html): Long-term debt structured around project economics and construction risk.
- [Real Estate Funding](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-real-estate-funding.html): Developer and asset-owner financing across the project lifecycle.
- [Land Acquisition Funding](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-land-acquisition-funding.html): Structured capital for land and development rights before construction.
- [TDR Funding](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-tdr-funding.html): Capital for Transferable Development Rights purchases in Mumbai and MMR.
- [Approval Funding](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-approval-funding.html): Pre-construction capital for statutory approvals and premiums.
- [FSI Premium Funding](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-fsi-premium-funding.html): Capital to pay fungible/premium FSI charges and unlock saleable area.
- [Construction Finance](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-construction-finance.html): Milestone-linked funding for the active building phase.
- [Redevelopment Finance](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-redevelopment-finance.html): Corpus, transit rent and construction funding for Mumbai/MMR redevelopment.
- [Stalled Project Funding](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-stalled-project-funding.html): Diagnosis and completion capital for projects that have stopped mid-way.
- [Working Capital Finance](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-working-capital-finance.html): Cash Credit, WCDL, LC, BG and limit enhancement.
- [Supply Chain Finance](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-supply-chain-finance.html): Anchor-led, TReDS and invoice discounting structures.
- [Lease Rental Discounting](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-lease-rental-discounting.html): Rent-backed institutional capital.
- [Strategic Finance Advisory](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-strategic-finance-advisory.html): Financial governance, capital planning and institutional readiness.
- [Credit Rating Advisory](https://equifinadvisory.com/service-credit-rating-advisory.html): Rating enhancement strategy.
